implementation.base: grenade_stat/melee_stat Buff points remains the explicit host input; initialized even at zero before modifiers are expected to work.
implementation.profiles: character_stats adds grenade_stat/melee_stat, sums bonuses then clamps 0..200. Same fragment family uses MAX.
implementation.curves: arcbolt_energy and threaded_spike_energy now query derived attributes before existing passive and chunk curves. Curve saturation at 100 and independent .75/.8 CES are unchanged.
implementation.sampling: Current recipient at gain; settled old rate then new rate at source changes. Fixed energy returns bypass the gain profile as before.
implementation.world_evidence: Physical Firesprite collection changes grenade payout according to Char at collection time; real tick Eruption removal splits melee passive rates and current fragment selection changes chunk grants.

limits: Cross-subclass Arcbolt/Threaded Spike accounts are synthetic consumers, not a claim of legal D2 Solar loadouts.
Host base-stat initialization and real armor point aggregation remain unassembled.
The inherited passive/energy formulas are community fits, not remeasured by this change.
Solar ability catalog, production subclass restrictions, HUD and persistence remain incomplete.
